claims: A note written with 25 or fewer ignored paths is byte-for-byte the note main writes.
takeover reports ready only if every ignored path the note was written with, other than a key file, exists in the checkout, wherever it sits in the list and whatever characters it holds.
A note from 0.1.3 or older whose list was cut, and any ignored-rest line that is damaged, short, long or not a list of path and kind items, gives ready false and never raises.
A missing key file, listed or after the 25th, is reported in missing_keys and does not block.
No note that main writes for a checkout with ordinary paths reads as not ready because of the new line-by-line rule.
plugins/ is rebuilt from skills/ at 0.1.4.
